newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three skin divers die on French Riviera.
newsitem.headline: Three skin divers die on French Riviera.

text.p: Three skin divers, including a diving instructor, died on Monday while exploring a grotto near the French Riviera resort city Antibes, rescue workers said.
The dead, two men and a woman, were part of a group of 11 exploring the grotto. Three others in the group were injured, including one who was being treated in a high-pressure oxygen chamber.
There was no immediate explanation of how the deaths and injuries occurred, the emergency workers said.
About 30 people were involved in the rescue effort, including one who was also being treated in a hyperbaric chamber for a decompression problem, they said.
